On a day when points came tough – and when a lot of other things came tough, too – the Jaguars rallied, fought and came close in a high-profile game between division leaders. But close wasn't enough.

Quarterback [Trevor Lawrence](https://www.jaguars.com/team/players-roster/trevor-lawrence/ "Trevor Lawrence") threw a late touchdown with two interceptions, and the Jaguars' defense played spirited and stingy, but a second-half near-rally fell frustratingly short in a [23-18 loss to the New York Giants at MetLife Stadium](https://www.jaguars.com/game-day/2026/reg-week11/jaguars-at-giants/) late Sunday afternoon.

"We got outplayed and outcoached," [Jaguars Head Coach Liam Coen](https://www.jaguars.com/team/coaches-roster/liam-coen) said, with Lawrence calling it "a rough day for us."
